idea-plugin.name: claudeStruct
idea-plugin.description:
Token-efficient Claude Code companion for JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, RubyMine, Android Studio …).

Right-click a file (or use the keymap) to run one of:
  • claudeStruct: Review — structured PR review of the current branch diff or selected file(s).
  • claudeStruct: Dev — propose a minimal patch.
  • claudeStruct: Plan — architecture / planning.
  • claudeStruct: Debug — hypothesis-ranked debugging.
  • claudeStruct: Dashboard — recent run summary.

Output streams to a claudeStruct console tab. Configure the cs binary path + per-task knobs in Settings > Tools > claudeStruct.

Requires the cs CLI on PATH — pip install claudestruct.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — Initial sideload-only release. Five actions (review/dev/plan/debug/dashboard) wrapping the cs CLI. Settings panel for cliPath / effort / extraArgs.
